items.title_orig: Need help deciding what outfit looks best with my character.
items.article_text:
I have an OC Alexandria the Satyr Warrior that I have made quite a few commissions for, and over time she has evolved in terms of her design. She initially started out as a One Piece OC, and then became a D&D OC before finally a general OC.
 Throughout that I wasn't sure what outfits and designs worked best with her vibe. So I'm asking you guys what looks best with her?
 The pieces are (in order):
  
Ancient Greek Myth outfit by Pearl-Jam-Bud
 Pirate outfit by Screwpinecarapice
 Modern outfit by Soft Ghosty
 Modern Leather outfit by Satsscarlet
  
What do you guys think? Which looks best on her?
